name: Kentucky Governor's School for the Arts (GSA) 2027
org: Kentucky Center for the Performing Arts
city: Kentucky (summer program at Northern Kentucky University)
what_you_do: Spend 3 weeks in summer studying your art with other Kentucky teens. Arts are writing, dance, drama, film and photos, graphic design, band or string music, musical theatre, visual art and voice.
who_can_apply: Current high school or home school sophomores and juniors. You live in Kentucky, go to school in Kentucky, or have a parent or guardian who works in Kentucky.
pay_detail: No cost to the student. Application fee is $35 for one art form or $50 for two. The fee can be waived for students who get free or reduced lunch.
deadline_text: The application opened Oct 2, 2026 and is due Sunday, January 17, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET. Finalists are announced Feb 12. Final round is Mar 11 to 13, 2027. Accepted students are told Apr 9, 2027.
how_to_apply: Create an Acceptd account and open an application for your art form. Part 1 collects your two recommenders and Part 2 has your materials and answers. Finalists do a final round audition or review.
notes: Dates may change, says the timeline page. Final auditions are held in person at Northern Kentucky University. Some are online. Email gsainfo@kentuckyperformingarts.org with questions. Or call 502-566-5192.
